reason: Temporary residual tooling risk: Expo CLI and ESLint require Zod 3.25.76; the upstream fix is in major version 4. The requested Remotion Zod 4 override is not fully resolved in the lockfile; vulnerable v4 copies remain an audit failure. This exception applies only to the exact remaining v3 version, not vulnerable v4. Do not expose Expo dev/MCP servers to untrusted users or load untrusted plugin/config payloads. The production case and payment gateways do not use Zod. Reassess with the next compatible Expo/ESLint release.
